stories.title: Boy dies from gunshot wounds after being dropped off at Selma hospital, police say
stories.summary: An investigation is underway after a boy was dropped off at Selma Community Hospital with gunshot wounds and later died.

stories.title: Wrongful death lawsuit filed against Fresno Unified over death of 14-year-old Fresno High student
stories.summary: The family of 14-year-old Daniel Padilla Jr., who collapsed during a physical education class and later died, has filed a wrongful death lawsuit against Fresno Unified School District and several school employees, alleging a series of failures contributed to his death.

stories.title: Dolores Huerta honored during Celebration of Life in Bakersfield
stories.summary: Hundreds gathered Friday morning at Dignity Health Arena in downtown Bakersfield to honor Dolores Huerta during a celebration of life marked by prayer, music and tributes to her decades of activism.

stories.title: Deadly crash renews concerns about safety at Friant and Shepherd intersection in Fresno
stories.summary: A deadly crash at the intersection of Friant Road and Shepherd Avenue has renewed concerns about safety at a crossing that officials and advocates say has a history of serious collisions.

stories.title: New Downtown Fresno hotel opens as city leaders push revitalization efforts
stories.summary: After years of planning and construction, Downtown Fresno's newest hotel officially opened Friday, with city leaders celebrating what they say is another major step in the area's ongoing revitalization.
